profile.headline: Software Engineer I - Quality Assurance at Outcomes
profile.summary: Results-driven Software Test Engineer with 6+ years of experience in test processes, automation, and quality assurance strategies within healthcare. Proven in enhancing testing efficiencies, reducing times, and meeting requirements. Excellent work ethic, detail-oriented, quick learner, team player, adaptable, with strong communication skills. Committed to delivering high-quality software solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer I - Quality Assurance
positions.description:
• Contributed to the design and development of a CI/CD pipeline for the test automation suite utilizing Cypress, Bamboo, BitBucket CI, Jira integrated test management suites (Zephyr/AIO-Tests), and Cypress cloud 

• Developed and maintained automated test scripts using Cypress for UI testing and POSTMAN for API test

• Actively participated in Agile/Kanban meetings to monitor project progress and identify opportunities for
process optimization

• Collaborated effectively with team members to ensure consistent quality assurance throughout the software development lifecycle

positions.title: Product Validation Engineer
positions.description:
• Project lead on the development and finalization of test plans for consumer and mobile automation 

• Evaluated testing procedures and identified inefficiencies in manual testing to implement improvements resulting in a 30% reduction in testing times

• Leveraged Bamboo and Bitbucket to facilitate the seamless deployment of new code on release nights

• Ensured functional and technical requirements are met through integration testing, end-to-end regression testing, and performance testing

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer - Validation
positions.description:
• Executed and maintained Selenium Automation

• Crosschecked automation results with manual testing outcomes to validate bugs, facilitating efficient bug reporting to the development team

• Created and maintained documentation and Confluence pages for team reference

• Facilitated bug meetings, showcasing proficiency in bug tracking and resolution

positions.title: Customer Care Representative
positions.description:
• Generate fraud analysis reports following stand operating procedures guidelines and identifying potential at risk orders

• Resolve customer issues and concerns via email and telephone

• Ensure customer information is correct and updated by reviewing orders for accuracy and completion proper to processing orders

• Process customer application orders and payments

positions.title: Senior Support Analyst / Case Manager
positions.description:
• Created, authored, and maintained a comprehensive knowledge database for relevant articles specific to any issue or query

• Analyzed key metrics to ensure optimal staff performance

• Created and implemented training guide for Client Services

• Mentor and motivate staff through individual coaching sessions and career development

positions.title: Technical Support
positions.description:
• Boosted website efficiently by configuring third party Javascript scripts to work seamlessly on the CMS

• Resolved high complexity cases involving website code integration, product configuration, and inventory management with HomeNet

• Maintained relationships with clients while providing a high value of excellence and integrity

• Supported over 5,000 clients across the United States

positions.title: Corporate Device & Provisioning Specialist
positions.description:
• Processed incoming requests via e-mail, phone, and Remedy correspondence to multiple users across a global corporate environment

• Provided desktop-hosted to server-hosted Exchange issues for more than 12,000

• Broadcom employees from multiple departments and technical backgrounds

• Manage the requirements, supply, customization, and deployment of all corporate devices and accessories for over 10,000 employees worldwide

• Route and/or escalate requests to appropriate functional teams

positions.title: Brand Ambassador
positions.description: Drove business development and marketing efforts, which expanded the customer base and introduced new products into markets. Educated and trained both consumers and workers on current and future devices.
